partial_hw_slice_extent_head_cross_z_pro.contract_field_or_exact_clause: Sections 8 and 15: partial-H/W slices contribute zero bias/loss/gradient; fully valid neighboring slices remain supervised.
partial_hw_slice_extent_head_cross_z_pro.logical_derivation: The real SliceExtentHead pooling plus Conv1d sequence is executed, and only a fully-valid neighbor slice objective is backpropagated. Any gradient on the adjacent partial-H/W input feature is forbidden cross-z leakage from a masked-out slice.
